headline: US Stock Market Today: S&P 500 Futures Rise On Steady Growth And Calmer Yields
summary: The Morning Bull - US Market Morning Update Tuesday, Aug, 4 2026 US stock futures are pointing higher this morning, with E-mini S&P 500 contracts up about 0.5% and Nasdaq-100 futures rising roughly 0.5%. The backdrop is a mixed global growth picture. Manufacturing scorecards across Europe, such as the S&P Global Eurozone Manufacturing PMI at 51.9 and Germany at 52.2, signal factory activity that is growing but still cautious.
